learn.model: 🐱 The cat drinks because it is thirsty.
learn.notice: After because, we hear the reason.

items.prompt: Pick the reason for the umbrella.
items.why: Rain is the reason we use an umbrella. Because tells the reason.
items.whyEs: La lluvia es la razón por la que usamos paraguas. Because dice la razón.

items.prompt: Pick the reason for the sweater.
items.why: Cold is the reason for a sweater. The reason comes after because.
items.whyEs: El frío es la razón del suéter. La razón va después de because.

items.prompt: Pick the reason the bird flies.
items.why: Wings are the reason a bird can fly.
items.whyEs: Las alas son la razón por la que un pájaro puede volar.

items.model: 🍎 Mia eats an apple because she is hungry.
items.why: Because tells why Mia eats: she is hungry.
items.whyEs: Because dice por qué come Mia: tiene hambre.

items.prompt: Tap every sentence that uses because well.

options.text: 🐸 The frog jumps because it sees a bug.
🐸 The frog sleeps because it is wide awake.
🐢 The turtle hides because it is scared.
🐢 The turtle drinks because it is not thirsty.

items.why: A good reason explains why. Wide awake does not explain sleeping.
items.whyEs: Una buena razón explica por qué. Estar bien despierto no explica dormir.

items.prompt: Pick the reason for the nap.
items.why: Sleepy is the reason for a nap.
items.whyEs: Tener sueño es la razón de la siesta.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence out loud with because: I smile because ...
write.promptEs: Termina la oración en voz alta con because: I smile because ...

label: It sounds like a whole idea
Suena como una idea completa

write.model: I smile because I see my friend.

familyTalk.en: At dinner, finish together: 'I like my coat because ...'
familyTalk.es: En la cena, terminen juntos: 'I like my coat because ...'

teacherTip.en: Have children say the because sentence to a partner before choosing. Clap once on the word because.
teacherTip.es: Pide que digan la oración con because a un compañero antes de elegir. Aplaude una vez en la palabra because.

learn.model: 🍪 The cookie is small, but it is yummy.
learn.notice: After but, we hear something different.

items.prompt: Pick the surprise for the ant.
items.why: Strong is a surprise for a tiny ant. But shows a surprise.
items.whyEs: Fuerte es una sorpresa para una hormiga diminuta. But muestra una sorpresa.

items.prompt: Pick the surprise for the rain.
items.why: Splashing is the surprise. Rain is usually not fun, but we have fun anyway.
items.whyEs: Chapotear es la sorpresa. Con lluvia no siempre jugamos, pero aquí nos divertimos.

items.prompt: Pick the surprise for the penguin.
items.text: 🐧 The penguin is a bird, but ...
items.why: A bird that cannot fly is a surprise.
items.whyEs: Un ave que no puede volar es una sorpresa.

items.model: 🍋 The lemon is sour, but we like it.
items.why: But shows a surprise: sour, yet we like it.
items.whyEs: But muestra una sorpresa: es ácido, pero nos gusta.

items.prompt: Tap every sentence that uses but for a surprise.

options.text: 🦆 The duck is small, but it swims well.
🦆 The duck is small, so it fits here.
🐕 The dog is old, but it still runs.
🐕 The dog is tired because it ran.

items.why: But shows a surprise. So and because do other jobs.
items.whyEs: But muestra una sorpresa. So y because hacen otros trabajos.

items.prompt: Pick the surprise for the fish.
items.text: 🐟 The fish has no legs, but ...
items.why: Swimming fast with no legs is the surprise.
items.whyEs: Nadar rápido sin patas es la sorpresa.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence out loud with but: I am little, but ...
write.promptEs: Termina la oración en voz alta con but: I am little, but ...

label: It sounds like a whole idea
Suena como una idea completa

write.model: I am little, but I can help.

familyTalk.en: At home, finish together: 'The kitten is small, but ...'
familyTalk.es: En casa, terminen juntos: 'The kitten is small, but ...'

teacherTip.en: Use a hand motion: palms together for the first idea, then open them wide for the surprise after but.
teacherTip.es: Usa un gesto: palmas juntas para la primera idea y ábrelas para la sorpresa después de but.

learn.ruleEs: So dice lo que pasa después.
learn.model: 🌧️ It is raining, so we use umbrellas.
learn.notice: After so, we hear the result.

items.prompt: Pick the result for the sunny day.
items.why: A hat helps in the sun. So tells the result.
items.whyEs: Un sombrero ayuda con el sol. So dice el resultado.

items.prompt: Pick the result for the cold girl.
items.why: A cold girl puts on a coat. That is the result.
items.whyEs: Una niña con frío se pone un abrigo. Ese es el resultado.

items.prompt: Pick the result for the dark room.
items.why: We turn on the light when it is dark.
items.whyEs: Encendemos la luz cuando está oscuro.

items.model: 🍽️ Leo is hungry, so he eats lunch.
items.why: So tells the result: Leo is hungry, so he eats.
items.whyEs: So dice el resultado: Leo tiene hambre, así que come.

items.prompt: Tap every sentence that uses so.

options.text: 🐶 The dog is dirty, so Dad gives it a bath.
🎂 We sing because it is Mia's birthday.
🎂 It is Mia's birthday, so we sing.
🐶 The dog is dirty because it played in mud.

items.why: So comes before the result. Because comes before the reason.
items.whyEs: So va antes del resultado. Because va antes de la razón.

items.prompt: Pick the result for the empty cup.
items.why: Filling the cup is what happens next. An empty cup gets filled.
items.whyEs: Llenar el vaso es lo que pasa después. Un vaso vacío se llena.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence out loud with so: I am tired, so ...
write.promptEs: Termina la oración en voz alta con so: I am tired, so ...

label: It sounds like a whole idea
Suena como una idea completa

write.model: I am tired, so I go to bed.

familyTalk.en: At bedtime, finish together: 'It is dark, so ...'
familyTalk.es: A la hora de dormir, terminen juntos: 'It is dark, so ...'

teacherTip.en: Pair so with an action: say the first idea, then step forward when you say so and the result.
teacherTip.es: Une so con una acción: di la primera idea y da un paso al frente al decir so y el resultado.
